scope: Explicit lattices only; no universal determinant or equality-classification claim.
second_agent_review: No mathematical convention defect found. CAS namespace/type resolution remains unexecuted.
reviewed_api_conventions: LatticeWithGram uses the supplied Gram matrix and checks positive definiteness by default.
Minimum/ShortestVectors/KissingNumber/ThetaSeries explicitly use Proof=true; no Prune or Max parameter.
ShortestVectors returns one vector per sign pair; theta exponents are squared norms.
Dual uses Rescale=false; its determinant is asserted equal to the reciprocal primal determinant.
SmithForm returns S,P,Q and P*G*Q=S is checked with unimodularity.
Default automorphism action is on coordinate row vectors; U*G*Transpose(U)=G is checked.
SetQuitOnError(true) makes errors terminate the script.
local_checks_actually_run: Generated literal files compared byte-for-byte with fresh JSON export
reason_not_run: Required CAS executable is absent from PATH.
